# Summit.js

> The open source, AI Agent Native JavaScript framework. Add behavior directly in your HTML with signal-powered s- directives and $ magics. No build step, CSP-safe, about 16KB with focus, positioning, persistence, and masking built in.

Summit is HTML-first: behavior lives on your markup as `s-` directives and `$` magics, evaluated by a small CSP-safe interpreter. The documentation is the markdown in the repository's content/ folder (https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/tree/main/content), and the project page is https://summitjs.velofy.co/. The full corpus is also available as one markdown file (see Optional below).

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/start.md): Summit is a rugged, signal-powered JavaScript framework for composing behavior directly in your HTML. Learn what it is and write your first component.

## Components

- [UI Library](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/components.md): An accessible, token-themed component library you copy into your markup and theme with CSS variables. Built with Summit, for people and AI agents.
- [Button](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-button.md): Buttons with solid, outline, ghost, subtle, and danger variants, plus sizes and groups.
- [Input](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-input.md): Text inputs and textareas with labels, help text, addons, and validation state.
- [Select](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-select.md): A styled native select bound with s-model.
- [Checkbox & Radio](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-checkbox.md): Accessible checkboxes and radio groups bound with s-model.
- [Switch](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-switch.md): A toggle switch bound with s-model, for on/off settings.
- [Card](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-card.md): A surface for grouping content, with header, body, and footer.
- [Badge & Tag](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-badge.md): Small status labels and removable tags.
- [Table](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-table.md): A styled table for displaying rows of tabular data.
- [Alert](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-alert.md): Contextual feedback banners for info, success, warning, and danger.
- [Avatar](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-avatar.md): User avatars with initials or images, sizes, and stacked groups.
- [Progress & Spinner](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-progress.md): Progress bars, spinners, and skeleton placeholders for loading states.
- [Tooltip](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-tooltip.md): A CSS-only tooltip that appears on hover and focus.
- [Dialog](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-dialog.md): A modal dialog for confirmations and focused tasks, with overlay and Escape to close.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-menu.md): A button-triggered menu that closes on outside click or Escape.
- [Popover](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-popover.md): A click-triggered floating panel for rich content, dismissed on outside click or Escape.
- [Toast](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-toast.md): Transient notifications that stack and auto-dismiss.
- [Tabs](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-tabs.md): Switch between panels with an underlined or soft tab bar.
- [Accordion](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-accordion.md): Collapsible sections, single or multiple open.
- [Breadcrumb](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-breadcrumb.md): Show the path to the current page.
- [Pagination](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/comp-pagination.md): Navigate through pages of results.

## Techniques

- [Techniques](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/techniques.md): Presentational recipes you compose with Summit's directives and classes: animated loaders, matte glassmorphism, retro interfaces, navbar patterns, and using Tailwind.
- [Loaders & Spinners](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-animation.md): A gallery of pure-CSS loaders: rings, dots, bars, shapes, animated logo marks, and skeleton screens.
- [Matte Glassmorphism](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-glassmorphism.md): Frosted, low-gloss glass surfaces that blur what is behind them while staying legible in both themes.
- [Neumorphism](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-neumorphism.md): Soft, extruded UI built from twin light and dark shadows on a matching surface.
- [Claymorphism](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-claymorphism.md): Puffy, rounded, playful clay surfaces with soft inner and outer shadows.
- [Retro UI](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-retro.md): Hard offset shadows and neon text for a retro, terminal, or arcade look.
- [Brutalism](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-brutalism.md): Stark borders, loud uppercase type, and blunt offset shadows for a raw, confident look.
- [Aurora Backgrounds](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-aurora.md): Slow, glowing color fields that drift behind your content for a premium hero look.
- [Glow & Spotlight](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-glow.md): A soft highlight that follows the cursor across a card, driven by a tiny Summit handler.
- [Navbar Patterns](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-navbars.md): Navigation bars with active links, a responsive mobile menu, and a glass variant, wired with Summit state.
- [Using Tailwind CSS](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/technique-tailwind.md): Summit for behavior, Tailwind for styling. They compose cleanly because Summit lives in attributes and Tailwind lives in classes.

## Essentials

- [Installation](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/installation.md): Add Summit with a single script tag, or install it from npm for use with a bundler.
- [Reactivity and State](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/reactivity-state.md): Declare state with s-data, derive values with getters, and add behavior with methods. Summit tracks reads and updates only what changed.
- [Templating](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/templating.md): Put state on the screen with s-text and s-html, and drive attributes, classes, and styles with s-bind.
- [Events](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/events.md): Respond to user input with s-on and its @ shorthand, including a full set of modifiers for keys, timing, and event control.
- [Forms](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/forms.md): Bind form controls to state in both directions with s-model, covering text, numbers, checkboxes, radios, and selects.
- [Lifecycle](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/lifecycle.md): Run code when a component initializes, react to DOM changes automatically, and clean up when elements leave.

## Directives

- [s-data](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-data.md): Declare a reactive component and its state.
- [s-bind](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-bind.md): Bind attributes, classes, and styles, with the colon shorthand.
- [s-on](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-on.md): Listen for events with the @ shorthand and a full set of modifiers.
- [s-text](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-text.md): Set an element's text content from an expression.
- [s-html](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-html.md): Set an element's innerHTML from an expression.
- [s-model](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-model.md): Two-way binding for form controls.
- [s-show](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-show.md): Toggle an element's visibility with display.
- [s-if](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-if.md): Conditionally render an element in the DOM.
- [s-for](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-for.md): Render a list, reconciled by key.
- [s-effect](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-effect.md): Run a side effect that re-runs when its reactive dependencies change.
- [s-init](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-init.md): Run an expression when the element initializes.
- [s-ref](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-ref.md): Name an element so you can reach it through $refs.
- [s-cloak](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-cloak.md): Hide markup until Summit has initialized it.
- [s-ignore](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-ignore.md): Skip Summit initialization for an element and its children.
- [s-teleport](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-teleport.md): Render an element at a different place in the DOM.
- [s-transition](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-transition.md): Animate elements as they enter and leave.
- [s-intersect](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-intersect.md): Run an expression when an element enters or leaves the viewport.
- [s-trap](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-trap.md): Keep keyboard focus inside an element while it is open.
- [s-anchor](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-anchor.md): Position an element next to a reference, flipping to stay in view.
- [s-collapse](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-collapse.md): Animate an element open and closed by height.
- [s-mask](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/s-mask.md): Format an input as the user types against a pattern.

## Magic Properties

- [$el](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-el.md): The current DOM element.
- [$refs](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-refs.md): Elements in this component marked with s-ref.
- [$store](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-store.md): The reactive global store.
- [$watch](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-watch.md): Run a callback when a watched expression changes.
- [$dispatch](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-dispatch.md): Dispatch a custom DOM event.
- [$nextTick](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-nextTick.md): Run code after the next DOM update.
- [$root](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-root.md): The root element of the nearest component.
- [$id](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-id.md): Generate stable, scoped unique ids.
- [$data](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-data.md): The current component's reactive state object.
- [$persist](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-persist.md): Reactive state backed by localStorage that survives reloads.
- [$focus](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/magic-focus.md): Move keyboard focus around from an expression.

## Globals & API

- [Summit.data](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/globals-data.md): Register a reusable named component.
- [Summit.store](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/globals-store.md): Create and read global reactive state.
- [Summit.bind](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/globals-bind.md): Register a reusable set of bindings.
- [Summit.directive](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/globals-directive.md): Register a custom directive.
- [Summit.magic](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/globals-magic.md): Register a custom magic property.
- [Summit.plugin](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/globals-plugin.md): Install a plugin that registers features in bulk.
- [Summit.start](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/globals-start.md): Start Summit and initialize the DOM.

## Reactivity

- [signal()](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/reactive-signal.md): A single reactive value you read by calling it and update with set().
- [computed()](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/reactive-computed.md): A cached value derived from other reactive state.
- [effect()](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/reactive-effect.md): Run a function reactively whenever its dependencies change.
- [reactive()](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/reactive-reactive.md): A deeply reactive object or array.
- [batch()](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/reactive-batch.md): Group writes so effects run once.
- [nextTick()](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/reactive-nexttick.md): Wait for pending reactive updates to flush.

## Advanced

- [How reactivity works](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/advanced-reactivity.md): How Summit tracks dependencies and updates the DOM.
- [The CSP-safe evaluator](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/advanced-evaluator.md): How Summit evaluates expressions without eval, safe under CSP.
- [Writing directives and plugins](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/advanced-extending.md): Build custom directives, magics, and plugins.
- [Migrating from Alpine](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/advanced-migrating.md): A guide for developers coming from Alpine.js.
- [Data Fetching](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/advanced-data.md): summitjs/net, a tiny reactive data layer whose resources expose loading, error, and data as signals that drive the DOM.
- [Error codes](https://github.com/velofy/summitjs/blob/main/content/errors.md): Every diagnostic code Summit prints to the console, what causes it, and where the docs link in each message points.
